indicator_name: Share of people who say most people can be trusted
area_description: Relationships, trust and networks between individuals and social groups are vital resources for the functioning of a society. They facilitate cooperation, mutual support and the joint tackling of challenges. A high level of social capital can strengthen the resilience of communities and helps to ensure that social resources can be preserved and used effectively in the future.
source_organisation_1: World Values Survey
source_url_text_1: World Values Survey - Online Data Analysis
